turns.q: How long will delivery take, roughly?
turns.replyTail:
Roughly 😊 Orders typically leave the warehouse within 2 business days when they don’t include a pre-order or custom piece.

After shipment:

Domestic Priority Shipping: 2–7 business days
U.S. Express Delivery: 1–2 business days
International delivery: 15–20 business days

These timeframes start from the shipment date and aren’t guaranteed. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time 💖
